s1.syndrome_frame: A tender, enlarging scalp lesion with a duration of 6 months, characterized by a bright pink, dome-shaped papule with overlying vessels
salient_findings: Bright pink, dome-shaped papule with overlying vessels
Concentric proliferation of ovoid tumor cells around small vessels
key_facts: 74-year-old man
History of multiple squamous cell carcinomas
Treated with Mohs micrographic surgery
6-month duration of the scalp lesion
5-mm bright pink, dome-shaped papule
Overlying vessels present
No purulent discharge or overlying skin changes
Hematoxylin-eosin staining demonstrated concentric proliferation of ovoid tumor cells
Tumor cells are hyperchromatic and variable in nuclear size
Scattered mitoses and necrosis present
Smooth muscle actin (SMA) was diffusely positive in the tumor cells
CD31 immunostain highlighted many endothelial-lined vascular channels

per_call: Multinodular and vacuolating neuronal tumor of the cerebrum

shortlist.label: Angiosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Bright pink, dome-shaped papule with overlying vessels and positive CD31 immunostain

shortlist.label: Epithelioid hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Dome-shaped papule with overlying vessels and positive smooth muscle actin (SMA) stain

shortlist.label: Pseudomyogenic hemangioendothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Tumor cells are hyperchromatic and variable in nuclear size with scattered mitoses and necrosis

shortlist.label: Retiform hemangioendothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Concentric proliferation of ovoid tumor cells around small vessels

shortlist.label: Dabska tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Hyalinized background stroma and endothelial-lined vascular channels

raw.rationale: The presence of hyperchromatic and variable in nuclear size tumor cells, scattered mitoses and necrosis, and the diffuse positivity for smooth muscle actin (SMA) along with CD31 immunostain highlighting many endothelial-lined vascular channels are consistent with epithelioid hemangioma.

rejected.label: Angiosarcoma
rejected.why: While angiosarcoma can present with similar vascular features, the lack of more aggressive histological features and the specific immunohistochemical profile makes it less likely.

rejected.label: Pseudomyogenic hemangioendothelioma
rejected.why: This entity typically shows a more myoid or spindle cell morphology and lacks the characteristic epithelioid features seen in this case.

rejected.label: Retiform hemangioendothelioma
rejected.why: Retiform hemangioendothelioma typically has a retiform or arborizing vascular pattern, which is not described in this case.

rejected.label: Dabska tumor
rejected.why: Dabska tumor is a rare vascular tumor that typically presents in children and has distinctive histological features, including the presence of hobnail endothelial cells, which are not mentioned in this case.
